conventions.time: CA steps = engine ticks of 500 ms at 1000 ms a chord; a tap at t lands after tick t
conventions.chords: [player, row, col, a, b, on, off]: a < b, the chord's two edge directions; off -1 = there at rest
conventions.boards: geo = type * 12 + rot * 2 + (mirror < 0), tile = Spectacle's tile index, both [row * w + col], -1 off the board
